acceptanceCriteria: corvint cem verify help/usage names --hunk-revert, its bounds (300 s per run, 1200 s total) and that it executes the target's tests unconfined
use-case receipts repinned if help.go is a pinned subject; the 12 doc gates pass
body: V1-1266 (PR #893) added the opt-in --hunk-revert flag to corvint cem verify (consumer hunk-revert falsifier for held, CEM-V1-088/089). cmd/corvint/help.go was outside that lane's scope and does not document the flag. Do after #893 merges; help.go edits may need the use-case receipt repin (script/repin-use-case-receipts.sh). Extended 2026-10-15: PR #944 (TCQ-V0-062) adds corvint cem verify --guarding-tests, which help.go also does not list; document both flags together.
title: Document corvint cem verify --hunk-revert in the CLI help text
